# Critique Pass One — Twenty Improvements

The Awtsmoos tests every plan by boundary and flame;
Awtsmoos.com improves not by volume alone but by proving each name.

1. Separate crawler coverage from user-visible semantic quality.
2. Never fix missing H1 with hidden text.
3. Never add `lastmod` without a real timestamp source.
4. Reject canonicals that redirect.
5. Reject sitemap URLs returning non-200.
6. Preserve authored noindex even on registered pages.
7. Preserve authored JSON-LD.
8. Treat query strings as suspicious in sitemap output.
9. Test Unicode/Hebrew URL encoding explicitly.
10. Test app registry href collisions.
11. Test game registry href collisions.
12. Test generated metadata file-path collisions.
13. Measure enrichment CPU cost independently of full app load.
14. Add sitemap XML byte/count limits.
15. Add comment alias pagination fixture beyond one page.
16. Add comment shard fixture beyond one shard boundary.
17. Add alias authored-post fixture with root and named series.
18. Add dynamic missing-entity noindex acceptance.
19. Add release-time public URL audit script reusable after every deploy.
20. Add developer-readable coverage report so failures are actionable rather than binary.
